page_title: ATA 4-1 SAL | Atalanta v Salernitana 18/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 4 - 1 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere puts the ball across the area and Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 4:1.
86' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to substitute Boulaye Dia and he is replaced by Jovane (Salernitana).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Teun Koopmeiners leaves the pitch and Michel Adopo (Atalanta) comes on.
85' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Ademola Lookman is replaced by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
83' 3 - 1 Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
82' Some neat passing and movement from Salernitana as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
77' What was Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
76' The game has come to an end for Davide Zappacosta. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
76' A quickly taken corner by Salernitana.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing. Salernitana get a corner.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Salernitana.
70' Salernitana fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch so that Giulio Maggiore can be given a rest.
67' Filippo Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Agustin Martegani will be replaced by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is replacing Ederson.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Muriel.
65' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
60' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) replaces Flavius Daniliuc.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) coming on for Loum Tchaouna.
55' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Salernitana was in an offside position.
52' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Ademola Lookman laid the ball off to Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
51' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Luis Muriel (Atalanta) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Benoit Costil, so the score changes to 1:1.
47' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A cross from Ederson (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ermano Feliciani had an easy-decision to make.

39' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
38' Atalanta are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
35' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Benoit Costil (Salernitana).
34' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

32' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Atalanta win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
31' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' The ball is cleared after Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
28' The Atalanta players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
26' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Benoit Costil (Salernitana) leaps to collect the ball.
23' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

22' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out of play. Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
21' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Benoit Costil displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
14' The linesman signals that Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.

10' 0 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Antonio Candreva sends a cross in and Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes low inside the right post and the score changes to 0:1.
8' A brilliant cross into the box finds Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
7' Atalanta fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
5' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
4' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
